semiconductor_relevance: High — Obducat provides advanced lithography solutions that are critical for the production of semiconductor devices.
summary: Obducat is a leading supplier of nanolithography technologies and equipment, enabling the production and replication of advanced micro and nano structures for various industries, including semiconductors. Their solutions support both R&D and high-volume manufacturing, making them a valuable partner for companies looking to enhance product performance and functionalities.
capabilities: Nanolithography tools for advanced micro and nano structures
